problem:
The absolute difference between the outcomes of one roll of two unfair six-sided dice follows the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table below. What is the expected value of the absolute difference of the outcomes for one roll of the two dice?

| $f(x)$ | $\frac{3}{10}$ | $\frac{9}{50}$ | $\frac{4}{25}$ | $\frac{7}{50}$ | $\frac{3}{25}$ | $\frac{1}{10}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ |

$\text{E}[X]=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =0\cdot f(0)+1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3)+4\cdot f(4)+5\cdot f(5) \\  & =0(\frac{3}{10})+1(\frac{9}{50})+2(\frac{4}{25})+3(\frac{7}{50})+4(\frac{3}{25})+5(\frac{1}{10}) \\  & =\frac{9}{50}+\frac{8}{25}+\frac{21}{50}+\frac{12}{25}+\frac{1}{2} \\  & =\frac{9}{50}+\frac{16}{50}+\frac{21}{50}+\frac{24}{50}+\frac{25}{50} \\  & =\frac{9+16+21+24+25}{50} \\  & =\frac{95}{50} \\  & =\frac{19}{10}.\end{aligned}
$$
